module_summary: Source half of a clearable gray-code CDC FIFO: a pointer submodule tracks the gray write pointer against the synchronized read pointer for ready, and a data submodule writes entries exported asynchronously.

anchors.name: src_valid_i
anchors.why: Source push request; combined with ready forms src_write.

anchors.name: src_ready_o
anchors.why: Not-full ready from pointer logic; gates writes into storage.

anchors.name: src_data_i
anchors.why: Source data payload written into the FIFO storage.

anchors.name: async_data_o
anchors.why: Whole FIFO storage array exported to the destination clock domain.

anchors.name: async_wptr_o
anchors.why: Gray-coded write pointer sent across the clock domain.

anchors.name: async_rptr_i
anchors.why: Gray read pointer from destination, synchronized for full detection.

anchors.name: src_widx
anchors.why: Binary write index from pointer logic selecting the storage entry.

anchors.name: src_write
anchors.why: Write enable to storage on valid-and-ready handshake.

groups.name: write_pointer_logic
groups.description: Gray write pointer, synchronized read pointer, full compare and ready generation.

groups.name: fifo_storage
groups.description: Register array written at src_widx on src_write, exported asynchronously.

groups.name: src_handshake
groups.description: Source valid/ready push interface producing the write strobe.
